verdict.rationale: Mailgun is an API-first email service, so it runs headlessly by design. The docs cover REST APIs and multi-language SDKs, a documented GitHub Actions integration for sending from CI workflows, scoped Domain Sending Keys suited to automation credentials, and webhooks that drive automation without polling. Missing for 10: an official CLI, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
